title: stelis pilosissima
intro: Stelis pilosissima, commonly known as the hairy stelis, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Stelis pilosissima include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
